gaps.sentence: Tax is calculated on your total annual ___.
gaps.hint: all the money you receive from every source
gaps.explanation: 'Income' is all the money you receive from work, investments, rent and so on during a period.

gaps.sentence: He ___ all knowledge of the missing file.
gaps.explanation: 'Deny all knowledge of something' is the fixed phrase.

gaps.sentence: Unemployment has ___ sharply since the spring.
gaps.explanation: 'Has risen' — rise does not take an object.

gaps.sentence: I start my new ___ at the hospital on Monday.
gaps.hint: a single, countable position of employment
gaps.explanation: 'Job' is countable — one particular position; 'work' is uncountable and cannot follow 'a new'.

gaps.sentence: Be careful not to ___ your keys on the bus.
gaps.hint: a verb is needed; meaning: no longer have
gaps.explanation: 'Lose' is the verb (opposite of find); 'loose' is an adjective meaning not tight.

gaps.sentence: The Sahara is the largest hot ___ in the world.
gaps.explanation: 'Desert' is a dry region with little rain; 'dessert' is the sweet course of a meal.

gaps.sentence: The medicine had an immediate ___ on her breathing.
gaps.explanation: 'An effect on' — the noun form is required here.

gaps.sentence: The children left ___ toys all over the floor.
gaps.explanation: 'Their' shows possession; 'there' is a place; 'they're' means 'they are'; 'theirs' is a possessive pronoun standing alone.
